description: General structure for every one-page headline review the app generates. Text in {braces} is filled from the analysis; nothing in this file refers to a specific company.

sections.heading: Narrative assessment
sections.guidance: At most 55 words: how well the current titles tell the story and what the recommended headlines change.

sections.heading: Recommended headlines
sections.coverage_note: Showing {shown} of {total} main-deck slides; see the full review for all recommendations.
sections.appendix_note: Appendix slides ({appendix_count}) are reviewed in the full analysis.
sections.rows: Main-deck slides only, in slide order. When not all fit, the opening slide is kept first, then slides are added by improvement priority (high, medium, low).

flag.legend: {symbol} Evidence in the deck is limited or conflicting; the headline is deliberately conservative. See the full review for the evidence gap.

sections.heading: Priority improvements
sections.guidance: Up to five, ranked most important first; fewer when fewer are justified. Title at most 8 words, detail at most 30 words.

footer.text: Findings are based solely on the content of the supplied deck ({source_filename}) and have not been independently verified; company claims are reported as stated. Recommended headlines are suggestions only; slide layouts were not edited or measured.
footer.generated: Generated {review_date} with Pitch Deck Headline Tuner.

deck.name: company_name
deck.label: Company name
deck.description: Only if the deck identifies it; otherwise empty.

deck.name: total_slides
deck.label: Total slides
deck.description: All slides in the file, including hidden ones.

deck.name: extraction_limitations
deck.label: Extraction limitations
deck.description: Unreadable or partially extracted content, with affected slides.

deck.name: narrative_assessment
deck.label: Narrative assessment
deck.description: Short deck-wide judgement of the story told by the headlines.

deck.name: slide_reviews
deck.label: Slide-by-slide reviews
deck.description: Exactly one review per included slide, in slide order.

deck.name: narrative_gaps
deck.label: Narrative gaps
deck.description: Story elements an investor would expect that the deck does not evidence.

deck.name: appendix_summary
deck.label: Appendix review
deck.description: One or two sentences on the appendix slides, reviewed separately.

slide_review.name: slide_number
slide_review.label: Slide
slide_review.description: One-based slide number in original order.

slide_review.name: current_title
slide_review.label: Current title
slide_review.description: Extracted or user-corrected title, or 'No identifiable title.'

slide_review.name: recommended_headline
slide_review.label: Recommended headline
slide_review.description: One complete sentence with an active verb, ideally 10–18 words, stating the takeaway.

slide_review.name: key_fact
slide_review.label: Feature / key fact
slide_review.description: The capability or fact the headline is built on.

slide_review.name: significance
slide_review.label: Customer benefit / investor significance
slide_review.description: Why the fact matters to a customer (product slides) or an investor (other slides).

slide_review.name: supporting_slides
slide_review.label: Supporting slides
slide_review.description: Slide numbers whose content supports the headline.

slide_review.name: cross_slide_support
slide_review.label: Cross-slide support
slide_review.description: True when support comes from other slides.

slide_review.name: evidence_excerpt
slide_review.label: Evidence
slide_review.description: Short verbatim quote, or a factual description of visible image content.

slide_review.name: evidence_gap
slide_review.label: Evidence gap
slide_review.description: Evidence that is missing or would strengthen the headline.

slide_review.name: conflict_note
slide_review.label: Conflicting figures
slide_review.description: Conflicting figures and the slides they appear on.

priority_improvement.name: slide_refs
priority_improvement.label: Slides
priority_improvement.description: Slide numbers the improvement applies to.
